description: Compute which scheduled maintenance services (oil, tires, brakes, filters, fluids, plugs, transmission, battery) are due, soon or ok from the current odometer and optional per-service history. Returns km and month distances to each due point.

id.description: Service id from the maintenance table, e.g. oil_change

months_ago.description: Months since this service was last done

odometer.description: Odometer when this service was last done (same unit as above)

months_since_last_oil.description: Months since the last oil change; time baseline for items without their own history

unit.description: Unit of the odometer values, default km

name: due_services
